modern: How does the ruling faculty make use of itself? For everything lies in this. But everything else, whether it is in the power of your will or not, is only lifeless ashes and smoke.
original: How does the ruling faculty make use of itself? for all lies in this. But everything else, whether it is in the power of thy will or not, is only lifeless ashes and smoke.
